lead.claim: A new scale can track post-exertional malaise in ME/CFS.
lead.context: Why this matters: *The Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) was developed and evaluated for measuring post-exertional malaise in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome patients.*

supporting.claim: TUG, gait speed, and grip strength have limited ability to identify fallers.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This cohort study investigated associations and discriminative performance of Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength for falls in community-dwelling older adults.*
